observations.title: Saved from Islamic extremists, Mali manuscripts face damage in new home | Fox News
observations.page_title: Saved from Islamic extremists, Mali manuscripts face damage in new home
observations.page_description: After being spirited away from under the noses of rampaging Islamic extremists, thousands of ancient manuscripts from the fabled city of Timbuktu now face another threat: weather and poor storage conditions in their new location that scholars say could cause permanent damage.
